page_title: FRE 2-3 LEV | Freiburg v Bayer Leverkusen 17/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' A dangerous towering header by Maximilian Philipp (Freiburg) from around the penalty spot goes just over the bar. This corner kick didn't change the score.
90+4' Florent Muslija (Freiburg) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
90+3' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' Alejandro Grimaldo receives a sweet pass inside the box from Jonathan Tah (Bayer Leverkusen), but one of the defenders is first to the ball and makes an interception.
89' Substitution. Exequiel Palacios is replaced by Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen).
88' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bayer Leverkusen.
86' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His effort towards the left post is saved by Noah Atubolu. Bayer Leverkusen have a corner.
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) replaces Adam Hlozek.
83' Xabi Alonso decides to make a substitution. Jeremie Frimpong will be replaced by Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen).
82' Bayer Leverkusen have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
82' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) blows a clear opportunity to score as he rattles the left post from point-blank range.
79' 2 - 3 Goal! 2:3. Yannik Keitel (Freiburg) taps home from almost on the goal line after a lucky rebound fell at his feet.
79' Yannik Keitel (Freiburg) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
77' Now Freiburg have a corner.
76' The game has come to an end for Patrik Schick. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen).
76' Christian Streich has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Yannik Keitel (Freiburg) replacing Merlin Rohl.
76' Lucas Holer goes off the pitch and Maximilian Philipp (Freiburg) comes on.
76' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a superb lead pass into the penalty area and finds Adam Hlozek, who fails to shoot.
75' The attendance for today's match is 34700.
74' A quickly taken corner by Bayer Leverkusen.
73' The free kick from the edge of the box is taken by Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen), but he hits it straight in the defensive wall.
73' Bayer Leverkusen get the opportunity to endanger the opposition's goal with a free kick from the edge of the box.
72' Harm Osmers shows a yellow card to Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg) for a tough tackle.
71' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
70' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
67' Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
66' Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Harm Osmers signals.
62' Substitution. Florent Muslija has come on for Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg).
62' Christian Streich has decided to make a change. Philipp Lienhart (Freiburg) replaces Matthias Ginter.
62' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) comes onto the pitch so that Roland Sallai can be given a rest.
59' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) latches on to a lofted pass and strikes the ball! His attempt flies narrowly wide of the left post.
57' What a chance that is! Merlin Rohl (Freiburg) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross, but he sends his header narrowly wide of the right post.

53' 1 - 3 Sensational! Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) shows off his superb ability as he volleys the ball from inside the box onto the left post and in the net. The assist goes to Jeremie Frimpong and the score changes to 1:3.
52' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bayer Leverkusen comes to nothing.
50' The resulting set piece from Bayer Leverkusen is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

49' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Bayer Leverkusen.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Jonathan Tah (Bayer Leverkusen) jumps for a header from the resulting corner kick and sends the ball in on goal, but the goalkeeper makes a very good save.
45+1' Bayer Leverkusen get a corner.
45+1' Bayer Leverkusen failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
45+1' Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Lukas Hradecky pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
44' The linesman raises his flag. Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) is adjudged offside.
40' 1 - 2 Goal 1:2! Adam Hlozek (Bayer Leverkusen) taps home from close range after the rebound fell kindly into his path.

40' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Noah Atubolu to get hold of the ball.
38' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) unleashes a shot, but it's well wide of the right-hand post.
34' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
33' Bayer Leverkusen take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
33' Adam Hlozek (Bayer Leverkusen) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on. Bayer Leverkusen earn a corner.
31' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
30' Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) tries his luck with a shot from long distance after receiving a good pass. He hits the ball poorly and sends it into orbit.
29' A player from Freiburg takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Bayer Leverkusen take the free kick with a short pass.
28' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
28' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) is penalised for holding. Harm Osmers signals a set piece. That's a free kick to Freiburg.
27' Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
26' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) fires a shot well wide of the right post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
24' Merlin Rohl (Freiburg) latches onto a decent pass, but flashes his shot just wide of the right post.
23' Harm Osmers blows his whistle after Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
22' The Bayer Leverkusen players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession.
20' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) fails to trouble the keeper from distance as his shot goes well wide of the right post.
18' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
15' Harm Osmers blows his whistle after Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
10' 1 - 1 Goal! Lucas Holer shows great vision to find Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the bottom right corner. 1:1.
9' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
8' Jonathan Tah (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar.
7' The Bayer Leverkusen players are exchanging some short passes.

2' 0 - 1 Goal Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen)! Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) was put through by Alejandro Grimaldo and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the right side of the net. 0:1.
1' The first half has started.
Freiburg will kick the game off.
Harm Osmers is the one to supervise the game today.
